questions.prompt: In Cleveland's 2023 overtime comeback against Chicago, how many points did Donovan Mitchell score?
questions.context: Donovan Mitchell · Cavaliers vs. Bulls · January 2023

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: career-high, and Cavaliers-record 71 points, along with eight rebounds and 11 assists

funFacts.text: Mitchell also grabbed eight boards and dished 11 assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: along with eight rebounds and 11 assists

funFacts.text: He became the first 70-point scorer with at least 10 assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first to do so with at least 10 assists

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: in a 145–134 overtime win over the Chicago Bulls

questions.prompt: Sick before Game 5 of the 1997 Finals, how many points did Michael Jordan score in the "Flu Game"?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan played 44 minutes, finishing the game with 38 points, 7 rebounds, 5 assists, 3 steals and 1 block.

funFacts.text: Jordan awoke in the early morning with severe stomach symptoms before Game 5.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan woke up and began to experience vomiting and diarrhea

funFacts.text: He later said he believed food poisoning from a pizza caused the illness.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan eventually claimed it was food poisoning in the 2020 docuseries The Last Dance

funFacts.text: At the final buzzer, an exhausted Jordan collapsed into teammate Scottie Pippen's arms.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan collapsed into Scottie Pippen's arms

questions.prompt: Before the shot clock, two teams played a game with only one shot in each overtime. How many overtimes?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: played a six-overtime game with only one shot in each overtime

funFacts.text: The stalled-out marathon was played by the Rochester Royals and Indianapolis Olympians.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Rochester Royals and Indianapolis Olympians played a six-overtime game

funFacts.text: Each overtime began with one side holding possession until a desperate last-second shot.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team that had the ball first held it for the entirety of the period before attempting a last-second shot

funFacts.text: The league experimented with other anti-stalling changes before adopting a formal shot clock.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The NBA tried several rule changes in the early 1950s to speed up the game

questions.prompt: In Durant's famous pull-up Finals Game 3 three over LeBron in 2017, how many seconds were left?
questions.context: Kevin Durant · Warriors at Cavaliers · 2017 Finals Game 3
